title: I Tried Waking Up at 5am for 30 Days — Here's What Happened
description: Thirty days, one alarm clock, zero snoozing. A full honest account of what changed and what didn't.
transcript: Three years ago I was working a nine-to-five I hated, sleeping in until the last possible minute every single day. Then I decided to try something different for thirty days straight, and it genuinely changed how I think about mornings.
